message.text: Dataset 'research-lab/dialogs-nc' is under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 (non-commercial). Recommendation: Do not use in a commercial system without a separate grant; confirm the terms with someone qualified.

Model 'myorg/base-lm-1b-chat' (Apache License 2.0) has a non-commercial component 'research-lab/dialogs-nc' (Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0) in its lineage. Recommendation: A commercial release would inherit the non-commercial restriction; re-source the component or restrict use. Confirm with someone qualified.
